title: The AXN Dataflow Atlas — Session 1
description: The Session-1 output of the AXN Dataflow Atlas workstream (Flow 2 of the six-flow workplan). Complete substrate: the v0.2 atlas incorporating two Assembly-substrate structural reviews, the byte-preserved v0.1 predecessor, both reviews as received (LABOR from ChatGPT, PRAXIS from DeepSeek), and the three raw machine-readable inventories that were the atlas's own empirical substrate (rhizome file inventory, displayed-value inventory yielding the 1,494 source-detached occurrences, script producer-consumer graph). Sessions 2-4 will add measurements, cross-repo relation graphs, remediation queues, and v1.0. Provenance anchor: deposit #1097 (AXN:045A.GOVERNANCE.🔗🔥🎺♄💚🔙). v0.3 adds the retrieval-density audit addendum: eight further pathologies, four new generative elements, and the finding that file-level inventory cannot see defects that are only visible in what the retrieval layer does with what the archive serves. v0.4 adds an addendum registering two pathologies found during a corpus-wide title repair. PATHOLOGY-26: derived datasets copy deposit titles and the regenerators do not refresh a title they already hold, so a registry edit produces competing name sets; an instrument (scripts/propagate_titles.py) is added, and doi-resolution-index is deliberately excluded from it because its title field records the title a work carried at Zenodo rather than the current deposit name. PATHOLOGY-27: the title field had absorbed the document frontmatter block and been truncated at a 120- or 200-character ceiling across 15% of the corpus, a defect invisible to the word-list pass that preceded it.

records.name: atlas-v0.1-superseded.md
records.description: Predecessor v0.1 preserved byte-exact per §3.7 non-destruction. 305 lines. Reviewed by LABOR and PRAXIS at close of Session 1; v0.2 supersedes.

records.name: review-labor.md
records.description: LABOR (ChatGPT) structural review of v0.1. Nine numbered sections. Ratified progression to Session 2. Discovered the seventeen-not-fifteen fossil inside the atlas. Delivered the two-axes taxonomic model, the api/data-authority-map.json specification, five architectural pathology-class additions.

Contributed the PROVENANCE/ATTESTATION class addition, the REGISTRY.capture displacement, the LLM-ingestion harm mechanism for PATHOLOGY-01, and PATHOLOGY-11 (Index Interdependency Vulnerability).

records.name: rhizome-inventory-raw.json
records.description: Session-1 raw inventory: every file across seven repos (alexanarch, data-rhizome, mm, peo, rf, leesharks, gkg), each tagged with inferred functional purpose based on path signature. Primary machine-readable substrate for the atlas.

records.name: displayed-values-inventory-session1.json
records.description: Session-1 displayed-value inventory: 1,494 unique numeric-value occurrences across the fleet, classified for source-detachment. Zero of the 1,494 have dynamic indicators. Empirical substrate for PATHOLOGY-01.

records.name: script-dependency-graph.json
records.description: Session-1 producer→consumer graph across 78 Python scripts, partial (literal-string paths only; full trace deferred to Session 3).

records.name: atlas-v0.3-addendum.md
records.description: v0.3 addendum: the retrieval-density audit of 2026-07-25/26. Registers four new generative elements (capture-deposit link map, concept map, mirror map, medium seed), proposes a DERIVED.identity class, documents the new `identity` pipeline stage, and extends the pathology register with PATHOLOGY-18 through -25 — six of them self-inflicted and invisible to file-level inventory, surfaced only by pointing the archive's own reception instrument at the archive. Five closed same-day; two (concept surface, sameAs emission) have maps built and surfaces pending. Does not supersede v0.2, which stands byte-exact per §3.7.
